name: cache-timer
description: A countdown in the prompt footer: under the hint line on the terminal, left of the model picker on the desktop: time left on the prompt cache and how much of the last request it served, or, when the cache was written again while it should have been warm, why (a model switch, an effort change); after a model switch, before anything is sent, what the other model will write. In Ghostty a big cache also raises a macOS notification before it expires and on a rebuild nobody asked for. Olive while there is plenty, warmer at 10, 5 and 2 minutes left (scaled down for a 5-minute cache). The lifetime follows Claude Code's own rules: 1 hour on a subscription, 5 minutes on an API key or usage credits.

lang.title: Language
lang.description: Band language: auto follows LANG (ru_* gives Russian), or pin ru / en

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: auto follows Claude Code's rules and corrects itself from request timing; 5m or 1h pins it

toast.title: One toast before expiry
toast.description: A single toast when the cache enters its last stage (2 minutes left on a 1-hour cache), only for prompts of 20k tokens or more

notify.title: Ghostty notification
notify.description: In Ghostty, a macOS notification 2 minutes before the cache expires and when it is written again with no switch of yours: for prompts of 100k tokens or more, any size, or off
